item.title: UN warns Hormuz shipping disruption threatens global food supply as two container ships sink
item.description: Two container ships have sunk near the Strait of Hormuz after being struck by missiles, amid the sharpest rise in Iranian attacks on shipping since the start of the US-Israel war with Iran. The disruption is threatening global food supplies, a senior United Nations official warned on Wednesday…
